name: WPadmin.AI – AI Assistant & Developer for WordPress
author: wpspin

sections.description:
WPadmin.AI helps WordPress site owners get answers and technical help without leaving the WordPress dashboard. It is now more compatible with page builders and popular WordPress plugins, including Elementor, Gutenberg, Oxygen Builder, Divi, Bricks Builder, Beaver Builder, Visual Composer, WPBakery, WooCommerce, Yoast SEO, Rank Math, Gravity Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Advanced Custom Fields, Wordfence, LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, and common custom themes.

The plugin has two clear parts:

  • WPadmin.AI WordPress Assistant helps with WordPress questions, troubleshooting steps, plugin suggestions, theme guidance, content help, and step-by-step instructions.
  • WPadmin.AI Developer plugin is optional paid Premium access for advanced troubleshooting, plugin or theme work, and guided WordPress changes from a managed staging environment.

The WPadmin.AI Developer plugin is powered by OpenAI’s Codex for advanced WordPress development workflows and will soon be integrated with Claude Code, giving paid Premium users more AI developer options inside the WordPress dashboard.

Learn more at wpadmin.ai.

Free and Premium

Free includes:

  • AI chatbox inside the WordPress dashboard
  • site-aware WordPress answers
  • troubleshooting guidance
  • plugin and theme suggestions
  • content and configuration help
  • 30 monthly questions

Premium is a paid plan and includes everything in Free, plus:

  • data-aware answers when site data is shared
  • Premium support
  • 150 monthly questions
  • self-serve access to install the WPadmin.AI Developer plugin from the WordPress dashboard
  • a managed WordPress staging environment for deeper WordPress changes
  • help with advanced troubleshooting, plugin work, theme work, and site improvements
  • guided live/staging sync workflow for approved changes
  • pricing shown in the client plugin: free for the first month, then $30 per month

What WPadmin.AI WordPress Assistant Does

WPadmin.AI WordPress Assistant is the everyday help layer inside the WordPress dashboard. It can help users:

  • understand plugin, theme, and WordPress settings
  • troubleshoot common WordPress errors
  • get plugin recommendations for business goals
  • write content in a usable format
  • request code snippets for common WordPress changes
  • understand WooCommerce, forms, SEO, security, and performance questions
  • analyze attached site data on the Premium plan when data sharing is enabled

What WPadmin.AI Developer Plugin Adds

The WPadmin.AI Developer plugin is available with paid Premium access for users who need more than answers.

After setup, WPadmin.AI can provide a managed WordPress staging environment connected to the live site. This gives users a safer way to work on deeper WordPress tasks, review changes, and sync between staging and live when needed.

The WPadmin.AI Developer plugin can help with:

  • advanced WordPress troubleshooting
  • plugin and theme development support
  • investigating harder site issues
  • guided implementation for changes that go beyond written instructions
  • developer-style workflows for WordPress users who want help making deeper site changes

Premium Developer Use Cases

  • Troubleshoot a plugin conflict that needs deeper investigation than written steps.
  • Review and improve a custom plugin or theme.
  • Build small WordPress features, shortcodes, admin tools, or theme adjustments.
  • Investigate WooCommerce, forms, SEO, cache, security, or performance issues in more detail.
  • Prepare changes on staging, review them, and sync approved work to the live site.
  • Get a WordPress AI developer workflow for custom-built sites where generic public answers are not enough.

Compatibility

The Free WPadmin.AI WordPress Assistant can answer questions about public WordPress plugins and themes based on site context and publicly available information.

WPadmin.AI is now compatible with popular page builders by avoiding unnecessary assistant loading on builder editing screens. Supported page builder workflows include Elementor, Gutenberg, Oxygen Builder, Divi Builder, Bricks Builder, Beaver Builder, Visual Composer, WPBakery Page Builder, Breakdance, and similar WordPress builder tools.

WPadmin.AI also works alongside popular WordPress plugins and site tools such as WooCommerce, Yoast SEO, Rank Math, Gravity Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Advanced Custom Fields, Wordfence, LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, and other widely used WordPress plugins.

With paid WPadmin.AI Developer plugin access, all plugins and themes are supported, including custom-built plugins, custom themes, and private site-specific code, because the workflow can work from the managed WordPress staging environment after pairing and workspace preparation.

Example Uses

  • Ask why a plugin is causing an error.
  • Get help choosing a booking, form, SEO, cache, or security plugin.
  • Ask how to fix a WooCommerce checkout issue.
  • Generate content for a page, product, email, or blog post.
  • Ask for a code snippet for a common WordPress customization.
  • Use Premium data-aware answers to understand your site setup.
  • Use the WPadmin.AI Developer plugin when you need deeper help with plugin, theme, or technical site work.

Privacy and Security

  • Prompt text and site context are sent to WPadmin.AI servers to generate responses.
  • WordPress admin requests use capability checks and nonce validation.
  • License and entitlement decisions are handled server-to-server.
  • Paid Premium Developer plugin access requires additional setup and customer verification before launch.

Privacy Policy: https://members.wpadmin.ai/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://members.wpadmin.ai/terms-of-service

Support

  • Email: integrations@wpadmin.ai
  • Website: https://wpadmin.ai/

Privacy

This plugin sends prompt text, site URL, and relevant site context to the WPadmin.AI API for response generation and license checks.

Privacy Policy: https://members.wpadmin.ai/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://members.wpadmin.ai/terms-of-service

External Services

This plugin connects to WPadmin.AI servers to provide AI responses.

  • Data Sent: Prompt text, site URL, and relevant site context
  • When: On plugin activation and when prompts are submitted
  • Service: WPadmin.AI (https://members.wpadmin.ai/)
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from your WordPress admin area.
  2. Go to Settings > AI Assistant for the WPadmin.
  3. Choose the Free or Premium plan.
  4. Start asking questions from the dashboard chatbox.

Paid Premium Developer plugin setup is guided by the WPadmin.AI team after subscription and onboarding.
sections.faq:
Is this a WordPress AI assistant?

Yes. WPadmin.AI WordPress Assistant runs inside the WordPress dashboard and answers WordPress questions based on your site context.

Is this a WordPress AI developer?

The paid Premium plan includes the WPadmin.AI Developer plugin, a managed workflow for deeper WordPress help such as troubleshooting, plugin help, theme work, and guided implementation.

Does this support Codex in WordPress?

The WPadmin.AI Developer plugin is designed for Premium users who want help making deeper WordPress changes from the WordPress dashboard, including Codex-powered workflows after pairing and workspace preparation.

Is this a WordPress MCP plugin?

WPadmin.AI is not marketed as a generic MCP server plugin. It is for WordPress users looking for practical AI help, site-aware answers, and a Premium developer workflow connected to their WordPress site.

Does this add Claude in WordPress or Claude Code WordPress?

Yes, Claude Code support is planned and will be released soon. Today, the WPadmin.AI Developer plugin is powered by OpenAI’s Codex for paid Premium users who want AI developer help inside WordPress.

Does the Free plan make changes to my website?

No. The Free plan focuses on answers, guidance, suggestions, and troubleshooting steps.

What is different in Premium?

Premium is the paid plan. It adds more usage, data-aware answers, support, and WPadmin.AI Developer plugin access after pairing and workspace preparation for deeper WordPress help.

How much is the Premium license?

Premium is free for the first month, then $30 per month.

How many sites can use one Premium license?

Each Premium license covers one WordPress site.

How many users can use one Premium license?

Unlimited users can use the license on the covered site. Pricing is not seat-based at this time.

  • Improved Premium onboarding copy for pairing token and managed WordPress staging preparation.

2.3.2

  • Shortened the WordPress.org short description to stay within the supported 150-character limit.

  • Improved compatibility with popular page builders, including Elementor, Gutenberg, Oxygen Builder, Divi Builder, Bricks Builder, Beaver Builder, Visual Composer, WPBakery Page Builder, Breakdance, and similar WordPress builder tools.
  • Improved admin performance by preventing the assistant chatbox from loading on post, page, custom post type, and page builder editing screens where it is not useful.
  • Improved compatibility with popular WordPress plugins and workflows by reducing unnecessary assistant loading during editing.

2.3.0

  • Renamed the public plugin to WPadmin.AI – AI Assistant & Developer for WordPress.
  • Updated public copy to explain WPadmin.AI WordPress Assistant and the WPadmin.AI Developer plugin.

  • Improved chatbox stability in wp-admin.
